description: Start (or fetch) the pre-hire direct-message thread for a proposal so you can message the candidate before hiring. Idempotent get-or-create — safe to call repeatedly; returns the conversationId to use with opentrain_send_message. Employer side only. Requires messages:write scope, the public_api_messaging_writes feature, and a claimed account.

proposalId.description: Proposal id to open the pre-hire conversation thread for.

name: opentrain_start_proposal_conversation
